---
name: Suggest a retrieval case
about: Propose a small query and the notes someone would want to find.
---

What would someone search for? Give the query and what they are trying to find.

Which note or notes would be useful, and why? Give each acceptable relative path and the passage or link that makes it useful. If no note should match, explain what the available notes cover.

Can someone try it with the bundled example vault? Otherwise, include small shareable Markdown notes labelled by filename. If a link matters, show the source, target and literal link. If you already ran the query, include the search mode, flags, and what actually came back.
